definition: Tiny-scale contrast that makes pores, fibers, and surface grit snap.

not_the_same_as.vec_acutance: Acutance is edge crispness. Microcontrast is fine tonal bite inside surfaces.
not_the_same_as.vec_optical_softness: Optical softness can reduce microcontrast, but it also spreads highlights and defocuses.

testable_claim: Raising microcontrast increases bite in fine texture without a required change in edge width.
